notes: The album wipe is fixed: a cleanup inside the app was taking away albums that arrived with an old automatic flag, and every one of them is rebuilt from the album tags your songs still carry the first time this version starts.
Your Albums tab comes back whole: names, songs and artists, in the order you had them, rebuilt from the tags on the files, and the songs inside each album are listed complete rather than partly.
The half-filled album is fixed too: an album rebuilt when you tapped the record player now holds every song carrying that album tag, not only the few that were free at that moment.

A cleanup can no longer destroy an album: any entry it still clears is kept with its full song list, and Manage albums offers it back with an It is mine button that restores the album exactly as it was.
Albums that arrive from a backup or a restore are marked as yours the moment the app reads them, so no later start can take them away again.
The lyrics letter wave, the timed lyric lines, the music player and the home-screen widget are all untouched by this release.
